title: What this capability is
content: Turns source-bound machine capability declarations into plain-language explanations that people can search, filter, preview, and inspect at increasing levels of detail.

title: Why it matters
content: People can understand what a capability does, what it needs, what it produces, and what remains unknown before choosing or changing an interface.

items: Search and preview a capability without changing it

items: Treating a declared capability as runtime proof

title: Failure modes and recovery
